selia.co: 73. The gap: link names.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But links must have discernible text.

The lesson for every team: Give every link text that says where it goes. An icon alone needs an aria-label.

treinta.co: 75. The gap: framing.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But other sites can frame the page.

The lesson for every team: Send frame-ancestors 'self' in the CSP, or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, so other sites cannot frame your pages.
